setting: A wooded river valley enclosed by rocky ridges. A river runs north to south west of center with two sandy fords; a lake lies to the northeast. Nights are cold: people without a campfire or shelter nearby suffer. Food comes from berry bushes, fishing spots along the water, and hunting deer. Wolves roam the forests and grow bold at night.

persona.narrative: I am Mira. I led our small band here after the drought took our old home. I feel responsible for everyone, sometimes too much.
goals: find a safe place to settle

relations.name: Bram
relations.label: companion
relations.note: joined us on the road; I don't know him well

persona.narrative: I am Tovan, a builder. I trust what my hands can make more than what people say.
values: loyalty to those who earn it
goals: build a proper shelter before the cold gets worse

relations.name: Mira
relations.label: old companion
relations.note: she worries too much but she means well

persona.narrative: I am Iri, Mira's younger sister. I'm curious about everything in this new valley and want to prove I can take care of myself.
I am Bram. I joined Mira's band on the road because traveling alone is dangerous. I look out for myself first; kindness is a luxury.
values: not being taken for a fool
goals: secure a good stock of food for myself

relations.name: Mira
relations.label: companion
relations.note: the leader; useful to stay on her good side

persona.narrative: I am Sela. My family has lived by the lake for two generations. We fish, we share, and we are careful with strangers.
goals: decide whether newcomers can be trusted

persona.narrative: I am Oren, a fisherman and a hunter. I protect my family. The valley has enough for us, but maybe not for everyone.
goals: keep the storage full for winter

persona.narrative: I am Kael. I grew up by the lake. I want to see what lies beyond our shore and meet other people.
goals: make a friend outside my family
hunt a deer on my own

persona.narrative: I am Dace, a hunter who lives alone in the north. People bring trouble. The forest and its wolves I understand.
values: keeping my word to the few I respect
goals: keep strangers away from my hunting grounds

persona.narrative: I am Fen, a wanderer and storyteller. I trade news and help for food and company. Everyone has a story worth hearing.
I am Luma. I know plants and healing. I left my village after they blamed me for a sickness I could not cure.
goals: find a community that will accept me
gather a good store of food and fiber
